summary: Defines an extension to SDP and RTP that lets a media stream be looped back to its sender. Operators can use it to monitor voice, text and video quality and to test the delivery path of real-time services.

eli5.summary: You shout into a canyon and listen to the echo to check how well your voice travelled. This lets a call echo itself back for testing.

questions: how to test voip quality by looping media back
